informed_by.phase3a4_result: At K=16 the global token-Markov-minus-trigram mean crossed zero (+0.028097 bits/event) while HMM space-free, HMM token-aware, slot-grammar, and copy-edit remained strong in 20/20 runs. The token-Markov strong-direction rule replicated in German and Italian but not French or Latin (2/4 languages), short of the frozen >=3/4 language robustness rule.
informed_by.status: post-hoc exploratory mechanism refinement, not confirmatory

inherited_replication_rule.purpose: Report whether any development condition reaches the already-frozen Level-2 directional hierarchy rule. Do not automatically select a confirmatory condition.

mechanism.identity_partition_control: Because the same 16-way variant index is mapped bijectively to one two-glyph pair in every condition, exact surface-token equality is preserved as an abstract partition across factorizations. Only the glyph-level representation of the 16 variant identities changes.
mechanism.information_note: Under ideal uniform variant selection, every factorization carries the same four bits of variant identity. The experiment therefore tests representation geometry and finite-order/local predictability, not a reduction in nominal variant entropy.
mechanism.master_factor_ordering: One deterministic four-state A ordering and sixteen-state B ordering are defined per source/seed; each factorization activates prefixes of those same orders.
mechanism.name: compositional_affix_factorization
mechanism.pair_mapping: For factorization R x C with R*C=16 and variant index i in [0,15], slot_a_index=floor(i/C), slot_b_index=i mod C. The pair is unique, so all conditions retain exactly 16 whole-token variants.
mechanism.token_length_control: Every ciphertext token is encoded-base length + 2 in all three factorizations.
mechanism.variant_index_choice: Use the exact Phase-3A.4 K=16 occurrence rule: stable_hash('base-form-suffix-choice-v1', seed, line_index, token_index) % 16. Plaintext token identity is excluded.

parent_phase3a4.lineage_requirement: For each source/seed, Phase 3A.5 must inherit the exact Phase-3A.4 TRAIN-fitted monoalphabetic base mapping and exact K=16 occurrence variant-index schedule. Phase 3A.5 is not byte-identical to Phase 3A.4 because it replaces the one-glyph suffix with a two-glyph code.

primary_prediction: With variant count and suffix length held fixed, the token-Markov-minus-matched-trigram delta is predicted to be lowest under 1x16, intermediate under 2x8, and highest under 4x4, while the other four Voynich-direction relations remain positive. This is an exploratory representation-geometry prediction rather than a guaranteed information-theoretic consequence.
question: Holding whole-token surface multiplicity fixed at 16, suffix length fixed at two glyphs, full base-form preservation fixed, and the occurrence-level variant-index schedule fixed, does increasingly balanced factorization of the 16 variants (1x16, 2x8, 4x4) improve the Voynich-direction predictive hierarchy by making the variant system more locally structured?
stop_rule: Do not add new factorizations after seeing results within Phase 3A.5. If none reaches the inherited full-hierarchy rule, retain the result and design a new mechanism intervention rather than tuning this grid post hoc.
